findings.title: `@Launch` defaults to expecting exit code 0, which will fail `testFeatureNotEnabled`
findings.body: In `UpdateCommandDistTest.testFeatureNotEnabled`, `@Launch({UpdateCompatibility.NAME, UpdateCompatibilityMetadata.NAME})` is used without specifying `exitCode`. Quarkus's `@Launch` annotation has a default `exitCode = 0` and automatically asserts that the process exit code matches it before invoking the test method. Because `UpdateCompatibilityMetadata.run()` now calls `picocli.exit(CompatibilityResult.FEATURE_DISABLED)` (exit code 4) when `rolling-updates` is not enabled, this test will fail with an assertion error expecting exit code 0 unless `exitCode = CompatibilityResult.FEATURE_DISABLED` is specified on `@Launch`.
